memoryRule: attention increments a private ledger without geometry change; a complete phrase is redistributed to the least-heard slot as a receiver, a real silence, and a chorus; later speech inherits the altered sentence
interactionRule: pointer proximity or Arrow keys attend without mutation; a typed phrase, Enter, Space, or speak control commits; Delete lifts latest; R or Escape releases
representationRupture: WebGL pressure casting rack, DOM double register, and SVG material plate -> Canvas 2D field of situated text fragments and produced absences
compositionRupture: depth-staggered blocks, two registers, and a folded plane -> one asymmetrical typographic ecology with uneven margins, breathing lines, and remote silence
encounterRupture: press-hold-release, approach-and-leave, and non-adjacent seam choice -> attend, type, and offer a phrase to a sentence that answers elsewhere
temporalRupture: elapsed pressure and departure memory -> collective attention ledger that selects the least-heard mouth for later utterances
mediumRupture: raw WebGL, semantic DOM text, and inline SVG -> deterministic Canvas 2D text rendering with actual visibility and word changes
changedRule: Attention is geometry-neutral. A complete phrase is not inserted at its offer: the least-heard margin receives a new mouth, another slot becomes a real silence, and a third carries a chorus fragment.
visibleConsequence: The blind view is an uneven typographic ecology of fifteen fragments. Four settled utterances show remote text mutations and absences; an interactive phrase materially changes three slots away from the input field.
falsifier: Delete if attention changes geometry, if the phrase appears locally, if remote roles are cosmetic, if the first view reads as a generic word cloud, if later utterances reset, or if exact lifting fails.
deletionCondition: Delete v036 if caption-free viewing cannot distinguish the ecology from a type specimen, rack, register, or decorative word cloud.
promotion: candidate / held pending local and production browser matrices, independent caption-free perceptual review, and provider revision linkage
